verdict.rationale: Qdrant is fundamentally an API-first product: it exposes a documented REST/gRPC API with official client libraries in Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Java, .NET, and quickstart docs show programmatic collection creation, search, filtering, and hybrid queries, all consumable by an AI agent. missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate OpenAPI paths 404) and independent hands-on confirmation specifically of API completeness/stability beyond general community praise for core functionality.
